darkelf.name: The Umbral Court
darkelf.style: hardened ash-grey dark elves, long angular ears, severe faces, obsidian segmented armour, tarnished silver edges, deep violet cloth, tiny amethyst lights, cruel elegant blades; predatory aristocratic menace, never cute, no generic black humans
darkelf.architecture: angular black basalt and tarnished silver, knife-like gothic spires, violet crystal lamps, hanging dark silk, spider-web tracery, obsidian terraces in a vast underground cavern

fishmen.name: The Abyssal Shoal
fishmen.style: monstrous amphibious fish men with visible gills, webbed clawed hands and feet, dead predatory eyes, mottled deep teal scales, corroded bronze, pearl and ivory shell armour, muted coral accents, restrained cyan bioluminescence; eldritch abyssal menace, no cartoon fish, no cheerful humans
fishmen.architecture: cyclopean sea-dark basalt, corroded bronze, ivory shell vaults and coral buttresses, restrained turquoise bioluminescence, tidal stone causeways on a storm-lashed coast, no underwater floating towns

de_gloam_spear.name: Gloam Spear
de_gloam_spear.desc: lean ash-grey elf in battered black lamellar, pointed steel helm, one long spear and small crescent shield

de_dusk_sentinel.name: Dusk Sentinel
de_dusk_sentinel.desc: lean ash-grey elf in battered black lamellar, pointed steel helm, one long spear and small crescent shield; upgraded with closed silver-edged plate and large hooked shield, longer serrated spear

de_shardbow.name: Shardbow
de_shardbow.desc: grim elf crossbowman in violet hood and black leather, compact two-handed crossbow

de_venom_arbalist.name: Venom Arbalist
de_venom_arbalist.desc: grim elf crossbowman in violet hood and black leather, compact two-handed crossbow; upgraded with armoured high-collared veteran with heavy recurved arbalest and small poison vial

de_knifedancer.name: Knifedancer
de_knifedancer.desc: athletic masked elf assassin in fitted black armour holding two curved daggers

de_blood_scythe.name: Blood Scythe
de_blood_scythe.desc: athletic masked elf assassin in fitted black armour holding two curved daggers; upgraded with severe silver death mask, layered spiked shoulder armour, two long sickle blades

de_cave_lancer.name: Cave Lancer
de_cave_lancer.desc: elf lancer astride a lean six-legged black cave lizard, violet saddlecloth

de_dread_rider.name: Dread Rider
de_dread_rider.desc: elf lancer astride a lean six-legged black cave lizard, violet saddlecloth; upgraded with heavily armoured lancer and silver-plated six-legged lizard with larger spined crest

de_veil_adept.name: Veil Adept
de_veil_adept.desc: severe grey-skinned elf sorceress in layered violet robes with single amethyst staff

de_mirror_witch.name: Mirror Witch
de_mirror_witch.desc: severe grey-skinned elf sorceress in layered violet robes with single amethyst staff; upgraded with tall silver headdress, floating intact mirror-shard halo joined to staff, deeper layered robes

de_silk_stalker.name: Silk Stalker
de_silk_stalker.desc: large threatening black cave spider with eight clearly separated legs, purple abdominal markings

de_widow_matriarch.name: Widow Matriarch
de_widow_matriarch.desc: large threatening black cave spider with eight clearly separated legs, purple abdominal markings; upgraded with massive black widow spider, silver carapace plates and enlarged violet-marked abdomen

de_obsidian_guard.name: Obsidian Guard
de_obsidian_guard.desc: towering elf executioner in broad black plate with a heavy two-handed axe

de_onyx_executioner.name: Onyx Executioner
de_onyx_executioner.desc: towering elf executioner in broad black plate with a heavy two-handed axe; upgraded with larger black-silver armour, high spined gorget, enormous crescent execution axe

de_gloam_drake.name: Gloam Drake
de_gloam_drake.desc: four-limbed black cave wyvern with two hind legs and two wing arms, folded violet membrane wings

de_eclipse_dragon.name: Eclipse Dragon
de_eclipse_dragon.desc: four-limbed black cave wyvern with two hind legs and two wing arms, folded violet membrane wings; upgraded with large regal obsidian wyvern, silver horn crown and sweeping violet membrane wings with luminous amethyst seams

fm_brine_spear.name: Brine Spear
fm_brine_spear.desc: lean gilled fish man with webbed feet, bone spear, small shell buckler

fm_reef_guard.name: Reef Guard
fm_reef_guard.desc: lean gilled fish man with webbed feet, bone spear, small shell buckler; upgraded with heavier ivory shell armour, coral-spiked crest, bronze trident and larger shell shield

fm_hookcaster.name: Hookcaster
fm_hookcaster.desc: hunched fish man holding a two-handed bronze harpoon launcher, spare barbed shafts on back

fm_abyss_harpooner.name: Abyss Harpooner
fm_abyss_harpooner.desc: hunched fish man holding a two-handed bronze harpoon launcher, spare barbed shafts on back; upgraded with larger eelbone launcher, deep-sea helm, multiple barbed shafts and bronze shoulder plates

fm_shellback.name: Shellback
fm_shellback.desc: stocky armoured fish man behind a huge weathered shell shield holding short cleaver

fm_barnacle_bulwark.name: Barnacle Bulwark
fm_barnacle_bulwark.desc: stocky armoured fish man behind a huge weathered shell shield holding short cleaver; upgraded with hulking barnacle-encrusted shell armour with enormous layered shell shield and bronze hooked blade

fm_mire_crab.name: Mire Crab
fm_mire_crab.desc: large low six-legged dark teal crab with two heavy front claws, coral shell nodules

fm_siege_carapace.name: Siege Carapace
fm_siege_carapace.desc: large low six-legged dark teal crab with two heavy front claws, coral shell nodules; upgraded with enormous crab with thick bronze-banded shell, serrated enlarged claws and shell siege spikes

fm_lantern_acolyte.name: Lantern Acolyte
fm_lantern_acolyte.desc: thin anglerfish humanoid in ragged teal robes, head lure and pearl-topped staff

fm_drowned_oracle.name: Drowned Oracle
fm_drowned_oracle.desc: thin anglerfish humanoid in ragged teal robes, head lure and pearl-topped staff; upgraded with tall abyssal priest with shell headdress, brighter head lure, ornate staff and heavy layered robes

fm_tide_mauler.name: Tide Mauler
fm_tide_mauler.desc: broad muscular shark-headed amphibious brute with scarred teal skin and two-handed anchor axe

fm_trench_reaver.name: Trench Reaver
fm_trench_reaver.desc: broad muscular shark-headed amphibious brute with scarred teal skin and two-handed anchor axe; upgraded with larger heavily scarred shark brute, bronze-and-shell shoulder armour and massive serrated anchor axe

fm_coil_serpent.name: Coil Serpent
fm_coil_serpent.desc: coiled amphibious sea serpent with two visible clawed forelimbs, dorsal fins and broad jaws

fm_storm_leviathan.name: Storm Leviathan
fm_storm_leviathan.desc: coiled amphibious sea serpent with two visible clawed forelimbs, dorsal fins and broad jaws; upgraded with massive royal coiled leviathan, ivory crown spines, armoured scale ridges and cyan-lit throat

fm_trench_titan.name: Trench Titan
fm_trench_titan.desc: towering bipedal deep-sea angler monster, two massive arms, lure, toothy jaws, coral back growths

fm_abyss_sovereign.name: Abyss Sovereign
fm_abyss_sovereign.desc: towering bipedal deep-sea angler monster, two massive arms, lure, toothy jaws, coral back growths; upgraded with colossal abyssal king with enormous shell crown, corroded bronze armour, stronger cyan lure and a huge coral-headed sceptre

de_dreadmarshal.name: Dreadmarshal
de_dreadmarshal.desc: armoured dark elf commander with glaive riding a lean six-legged black cave lizard

de_veilseer.name: Veilseer
de_veilseer.desc: hooded dark elf sorceress with violet staff riding a sleek black cave lizard

de_nightstalker.name: Nightstalker
de_nightstalker.desc: masked dark elf scout with compact crossbow riding a low six-legged cave lizard

fm_tidemarshal.name: Tidemarshal
fm_tidemarshal.desc: gilled fish man commander with coral trident riding a huge armoured six-legged shore crab

fm_deep_oracle.name: Deep Oracle
fm_deep_oracle.desc: robed anglerfish oracle with pearl staff riding a broad six-legged shore crab

fm_reef_hunter.desc: lean fish man harpoon scout riding a swift low six-legged shore crab
